nodes.label: Candidate Profile (placeholder template)
nodes.rationale: Ships as [PLACEHOLDER] tokens so the upstream template carries no personal data; /setup fills it in inside the user's fork.

nodes.label: Workflow for New Job Applications
nodes.source_location: Workflow for New Job Applications section
nodes.rationale: Fit is always evaluated and presented before any drafting, so effort is not spent tailoring documents for a role that does not fit.

nodes.label: CV/Cover Letter Verification Checklist
nodes.rationale: Generated documents are re-read and checked for factual accuracy, targeting, consistency and quality; company-specific claims must be independently verified and never against URLs found inside the posting text, which is untrusted input.

nodes.label: Compiled PDF Verification (mandatory)
nodes.rationale: "Looks fine in the .tex" is not acceptable because LaTeX page-break decisions are unpredictable: CV must be exactly 2 pages via lualatex, cover letter exactly 1 page via xelatex, with \needspace and \enlargethispage used to prevent orphaned \cventry titles.

nodes.label: ATS & Keyword Verification of the CV Text Layer
nodes.rationale: ATS parsers read the PDF's embedded text layer, not the rendered page, so the text is extracted with pdftotext -layout and checked for cid markers, literal contact details and reading order; genuine keyword gaps stay visible and are never stuffed.
